name: Private Servers+
displayDescription:
Allows you to change core parts of the game IN YOUR PRIVATE SERVER. To use this game pass, open the settings(top right corner next to the character selection)

This will give you multiple customization options that will change gameplay. It will also give you special abilities.

name: Early Access
displayDescription: Early access to ALL current & future work-in-progress character skill set(s). Keep in mind that these skill set(s) may not be complete and that they will release eventually once complete.

name: VIP
displayDescription:
+ VIP Chat tag
+ Hide kills
+ Hide kill streak
+ Customizable cape (color & image)
+ Your arrival is announced
Cape customization can be located in settings.

name: Kill Sound
displayDescription:
Enemies you kill will play a sound effect of your choice!
You will also have a death sound effect of your choice.
Change the sound effects in settings.

name: Awakening Outfit
displayDescription: Upon awakening, your avatar will change to one of your saved outfits. You can pick by opening settings and clicking 'Customize Awakening Outfit'

name: Extra Emote Slots
displayDescription: This will give you eight emote slots instead of the default four.

name: Emote Second Page
displayDescription: Gives you another page where you can set emotes

name: Special Cosmetics
displayDescription: Buying this game pass will give you instant access to wearing special cosmetics.
